title: synthetic-other-game
notes: Deliberately unlike the CSV fixture: every key name except the message list differs, numbers appear where the CSV uses strings, one page is addressed by an explicit leaf number, and speakers are absent where the CSV names them. docs/spec/04 Two-game portability verification requires a structurally different second game to ingest through the same core code, with mapping done by configuration rather than by a condition in shared code.

messages.line_of_dialogue: No coin, no crossing. That is the rule and the whole of it.
Fish have no pockets and spirits do not pay.
A wooden sign, half sunk: 'TOLL — ONE COIN, EVERY SOUL'.
Toll Coin. Warm, like someone was holding it.
You paid. I did not say the coin was yours.
He takes a coin from everyone who crosses. Nobody has ever crossed twice.
So the story goes. Stories are cheaper than coins.
The ferry is gone. The rope is still wet.
There is a second ferry. There is always a second ferry.
Reed-cutting knife — the edge has been touched recently.
Second crossing, second coin. I am not greedy. I am thorough.
Ask him about the first ferryman. Watch him remember something else.
A child's drawing of a boat, nailed to a post. The boat has no oars.
This is not a toll. This is a habit.
Far Bank — the road continues, unbothered.
